sentences.en: diana : So, Tim, we have to do a short summary of our work experience on a farm.
sentences.zh: diana: 那么，蒂姆，我们需要就农场实习经历写一份简短总结。

sentences.en: tim : Right.
sentences.zh: tim：好的。

sentences.en: My farm was great, but arranging the work experience was hard.
sentences.zh: 我的农场很棒，但安排实习工作却很难。

sentences.en: One problem was it was miles away and I don't drive.
sentences.zh: 其中一个问题是农场离我家有好几英里远，而我又不会开车。

sentences.en: And also, I'd really wanted a placement for a month, but I could only get one for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 另外，我原本特别希望能实习一个月，但最后只找到了为期两周的实习机会。

sentences.en: diana : I was lucky, the farmer let me stay on the farm so I didn't have to travel.
sentences.zh: diana：我很幸运，那位农民让我住在农场里，所以我不用每天往返奔波。

sentences.en: But finding the right sort of farm to apply to wasn't easy .
sentences.zh: 但要找到合适类型的农场去申请并不容易。

sentences.en: tim : No, they don't seem to have websites, do they.
sentences.zh: tim：是啊，他们好像都没有网站，对吧？

sentences.en: I found mine through a friend of my mother's, but it wasn't easy.
sentences.zh: 我是通过我妈妈的一个朋友才找到的，但过程也不轻松。

sentences.en: diana : No.
sentences.zh: diana：是的。

sentences.en: tim : My farm was mostly livestock, especially sheep.
sentences.zh: tim：我的农场主要饲养牲畜，尤其是绵羊。

sentences.en: I really enjoyed helping out with them.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢帮忙照看它们。

sentences.en: I was up most of one night helping a sheep deliver a lamb …
sentences.zh: 有天晚上我几乎整夜没睡，帮一只母羊接生小羊……

sentences.en: diana : On your own?
sentences.zh: diana：你一个人吗？

sentences.en: tim : No, the farmer was there, and he told me what to do.
sentences.zh: tim：不，农民也在场，他告诉我该怎么做。

sentences.en: It wasn't a straightforward birth, but I managed.
sentences.zh: 那次分娩并不顺利，但我还是成功完成了。

sentences.en: It was a great feeling to see the lamb stagger to its feet and start feeding almost straightaway, and to know that it was OK.
sentences.zh: 看到小羊摇摇晃晃地站起来、几乎立刻就开始吃奶，而且知道它一切安好，那种感觉真是太棒了。

sentences.en: diana : Mm.
sentences.zh: diana：嗯。

sentences.en: tim : Then another time a lamb had broken its leg, and they got the vet in to set it, and he talked me through what he was doing.
sentences.zh: tim：还有一次，一只小羊腿断了，他们请来了兽医为它接骨，兽医一边操作一边向我讲解整个过程。

sentences.en: That was really useful.
sentences.zh: 那真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: diana : Yes, my farm had sheep too.
sentences.zh: diana：是的，我的农场也有绵羊。

sentences.en: The farm was in a valley and they had a lowland breed called Suffolks, although the farmer said they'd had other breeds in the past.
sentences.zh: 农场位于一个山谷中，饲养的是低地品种——萨福克羊，不过那位农民说他们过去也养过其他品种。

sentences.en: tim : So were they bred for their meat?
sentences.zh: tim：那么它们主要是为了产肉而培育的吗？

sentences.en: diana : Mostly, yes .
sentences.zh: diana：基本上是的。

sentences.en: They're quite big and solid.
sentences.zh: 它们体型较大、体格健壮。

sentences.en: tim : My farm was up in the hills and they had a different breed of sheep, they were Cheviots.
sentences.zh: tim：我的农场则在山区，养的是另一种绵羊——切维厄特羊。
